distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) lists Taiwan but clarifies that P. formosanus was described from pine wood imported from Taiwan to Japan and is known only from the type series. This is retained as Questionable Taiwan evidence rather than direct established occurrence.

host_note: Pinus sp. is preserved at the source-reported resolution, but because the evidence comes from imported type-series material it is not promoted to Current Host Summary.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Polygraphus formosanus Nobuchi, 1967.

taxonomic_history.name: Polygraphus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current integrated taxonomic backbone retains Polygraphus formosanus Nobuchi, 1967 as VSN_4700. Beaver & Liu (2010) explicitly states that the taxon may be a synonym of P. taiwanensis; this unresolved synonymy is preserved as a taxonomic conflict.
